title: Jude and the Orchard
author: Ulyana Dunmore
blurb: Jude Ashgrove, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, has spent fifteen years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
